For PED-53686, I can't find any payment linked to this order at all, so it's unpaid.

Moving to PED-77777, there are two separate payments both matching the order's transaction ID, and their combined sum exceeds the order amount - this one is overpaid. PED-94508 shows the familiar refunded pattern: on-time payment followed by a complete matching refund. Now I'm checking PED-51689 - there's a payment tagged with this transaction ID, and I need to convert its UTC timestamp to local time to compare against the expiration.

Now that all orders are classified, I need to scan through every payment e2e_id and verify it links to an order - this will surface any orphan payments. Going through the list, E7659186380016 stands out since it has no transaction ID and an empty description, making it unlinkable to any order, so it's the one orphan. With that identified, I'm ready to assemble the final JSON output.
